dialogues.speaker: Dorofeya
dialogues.text: Ha! Just look at the children these days! See how magnificent and beautiful they are... Even I cannot help but be completely mesmerized by them!

dialogues.speaker: Dorofeya
dialogues.text: Oh dear... If you are posing a question like that to me, my star must have truly faded.

dialogues.speaker: Dorofeya
dialogues.text: My name is Dorofeya. I was a singer with the Korolevskiy Troupe for a few years.

dialogues.speaker: Dorofeya
dialogues.text: I suppose you can say I exited the spotlight early. These days, I am but a leisurely observer whiling my days away, courtesy of my husband's land holdings and a rather tiny income.

dialogues.speaker: Dorofeya
dialogues.text: It is also a distinct blessing to be here, far from the stage, lending my applause to those who have come after me like this.

dialogues.speaker: Dorofeya
dialogues.text: Goodbye. Do come by the theater when you can!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, you used to be an actor?

dialogues.speaker: Dorofeya
dialogues.text: Hehe... Indeed. You might not be able to tell looking at me now, but back in the day, I was the reigning star for quite a few years too. The bouquets showered upon me were simply countless.

dialogues.speaker: Dorofeya
dialogues.text: But... as you can see, youth and beauty are but fleeting illusions.

dialogues.speaker: Dorofeya
dialogues.text: The moment the singer loses her brilliant luster, all the nobles and rich men who had worshiped her so will simply vanish in an instant.

dialogues.speaker: Dorofeya
dialogues.text: For what they adore is that flawless illusion on stage, and not the person behind it. This is something I know intimately, as someone who wandered and begged in the streets of Gornylo as a child.

dialogues.speaker: Dorofeya
dialogues.text: This is why I chose to make my departure at the absolute zenith of my career. Fortunately, my husband is a nobleman who, dull as he may be, has a heart that is entirely true... As you well know, noblemen like that are truly hard to find.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you think about the current crop of actors?

dialogues.speaker: Dorofeya
dialogues.text: I must admit, there is a remarkable wealth of talent among them! If we exclude the veterans like Vodyanitsa entirely... the one who has really caught everyone's eye of late is that Miss Odette. She truly is magnificent.

dialogues.speaker: Akvilina
dialogues.text: As for Violetta... Ah, I once worked alongside her mother. Mind you, while she certainly cannot compare to a preternaturally gifted dancer like Odette...

dialogues.speaker: Akvilina
dialogues.text: When I watch that child dance, I always see... Hmm, how should I put it? Yes, I detect an absolute passion for ballet in every move she makes. That characteristic, coupled with a certain stubbornness that compels her to go all out in every performance, makes her a truly one-of-a-kind performer indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Akvilina
dialogues.text: Everyone is trying their best to dazzle and shine on stage — how wonderful is that?
